problem.title: First Unique Number
problem.problemStatement: Design a data structure that maintains a queue of integers and supports the following operations: showFirstUnique() — Return the first unique integer in the queue. If no unique integer exists, return -1. add(value) — Add an integer to the end of the queue. Initially, the queue is populated with a given list of integers. Process a sequence of operations and print the result for every showFirstUnique() operation.
problem.input: Integer n Array of n integers Integer q Next q operations
problem.output: Print the result for every showFirstUnique() operation.
